footprint_definition: Square footprint of half-width 0.25 degrees (about 28 km N-S) centred on the site. Smaller than the Mars footprint because Earth analog field sites are typically a few tens of km across; terrain statistics are computed on a grid block-averaged to the MOLA 16 ppd cell size (~3.7 km) so they are comparable to the Mars values.
